$comment: Where a key is filed: the two directory levels `<ab>/<cd>` under which the event log files a resource's stream and the views file its view (key: the resource id), the storage-uri index files an entry (key: the URI), and the anchored-text store files an entry (key: the content checksum). The shard is a 16-bit number written as four lowercase hex digits and split in two. It is computed over the key's UTF-16 code units: start at 0; for each unit, multiply by 31 and add the unit, keeping the low 32 bits as a signed integer; take the absolute value; take it modulo 65536. Every implementation that writes or reads these files runs every case and fails on any difference: TypeScript (packages/core getShardPath), which the Librarian and the Smelter keep using, and the Archivist. Add a case here before changing any implementation.

cases.why: an id of every safe character class
a hash that goes negative before the absolute value
a content checksum, as the anchored-text store keys entries
a storage URI with a space and a nested path
a storage URI outside ASCII: hashed by UTF-16 code unit, not by byte
a storage URI outside the basic plane: two code units per character
a storage URI in another script
